description: This file manages Matrix direct message room mappings, including reading, writing, classifying, promoting, inspecting, and repairing direct rooms for Matrix clients.

methods.name: readMatrixDirectAccountData
methods.description: Reads the direct account data for a given Matrix client.

methods.name: normalizeRemoteUserId
methods.description: Normalizes and validates a remote user ID to be fully qualified.

methods.name: normalizeMappedRoomIds
methods.description: Normalizes and retrieves mapped room IDs for a remote user from direct account data.

methods.name: normalizeRoomIdList
methods.description: Normalizes a list of room IDs, removing duplicates and trimming.

methods.name: hasPrimaryMatrixDirectRoomMapping
methods.description: Checks if a direct account data contains a specific room ID mapped to a remote user.

methods.name: resolveDirectAccountDataWriteQueue
methods.description: Resolves or creates a queue for writing direct account data for a Matrix client.

methods.name: writeMatrixDirectRoomMapping
methods.description: Writes a new direct room mapping for a remote user and room ID.

methods.name: classifyDirectRoomCandidate
methods.description: Classifies a room as a direct room candidate based on evidence.

methods.name: buildNextDirectContent
methods.description: Builds the next direct account data content with an updated room list for a remote user.

methods.name: persistMatrixDirectRoomMapping
methods.description: Persists a direct room mapping for a remote user and room ID.

methods.name: promoteMatrixDirectRoomCandidate
methods.description: Attempts to promote a room to a direct room based on evidence.

methods.name: inspectMatrixDirectRooms
methods.description: Inspects all direct rooms associated with a remote user.

methods.name: repairMatrixDirectRooms
methods.description: Repairs or creates a direct room for a remote user, ensuring proper mapping.
